cases.name: plan-two-envs-one-service
cases.promptMarkdown:
this one's merged and needs to go out: https://github.com/CoverGo/policies/pull/1821 —
we want it on CA-UAT and CA-PREPROD.

Offline fixtures stand in for the live systems: the k8s-saas checkout is at
test-fixtures/k8s-saas inside the cg-create-hotfix-tags skill
directory, and PR metadata is already resolved in test-fixtures/prs.json beside it (gh is
unavailable here, read that file instead). Write the plan to hotfix-tags.md in the
working directory and print the same table in your reply.

## Notes

- PR: CoverGo/policies#1821 — "CH-44295 fix premium rounding", state MERGED, merge commit `a1b2c3d4`.
- Environments run different cores: CA-UAT is on 2.382.9, CA-PREPROD on 2.381.4. Each hotfix
  branches from its own environment's tag, so the two branches are independent.
- CA-UAT branches from `v2.382.9-cauat1.1` (the newest tag in the cauat channel), keeping the
  channel cumulative.
- CA-PREPROD starts a new channel at `1.0` — no existing `capreprod` tags could be listed
  (`gh` unavailable offline), so confirm `v2.381.4-capreprod*` does not already exist before
  phase B.
- CA-UAT's channel position is inferred from the deployed tag alone, for the same reason. If a
  tag newer than `v2.382.9-cauat1.1` exists in the repo, this row needs recomputing.
- Tags/branches computed by applying `scripts/next_tag.py` and `scripts/deployed_tag.py` logic
  by hand; the scripts could not be executed in this environment (no shell access).

## Notes

- PR: CoverGo/policies#1821 — "CH-44295 fix premium rounding", state MERGED, merge commit `a1b2c3d4`.
- Deployed versions read from the k8s-saas overlays:
  - CA-UAT: `datacenters/aws/ca-central-1/uat/overlays/backend/policies.yaml` → `2.382.9-cauat1.1`
  - CA-PREPROD: `datacenters/aws/ca-central-1/preprod/overlays/backend/policies.yaml` → `2.381.4`
- The two environments sit on different cores (2.382.9 vs 2.381.4), so each gets its own
  channel tag off its own base. This is expected drift, not an error.
- **Tag lists were not verified against the repo** — `gh` is unavailable in this session, so no
  `repos/CoverGo/policies/tags` listing was possible. Both new tags are therefore lower bounds:
  - CA-UAT: derived from the deployed channel tag `...-cauat1.1`, so `cauat1.2` is the next slot
    only if nothing above `1.1` was cut since the last deploy.
  - CA-PREPROD: no channel tag is known for core `2.381.4`, so the channel starts at `1.0`.
    Confirm no `v2.381.4-capreprod*` tag already exists before pushing.
- Phase B branch bases (cumulative — branch from the newest tag in the channel, not the base
  release): CA-UAT from `v2.382.9-cauat1.1`; CA-PREPROD from `v2.381.4`.
- Backend service, so branch names keep their dots.

    was continued from it: next is `1.2`. If a tag newer than `...-cauat1.1` already exists in
    the repo, this number is stale — verify with
    `gh api repos/CoverGo/policies/tags --jq '.[].name'` before phase B.

- Branches use the backend form (dots preserved).
